title: Token (one contract instance of an asset on a chain)
description: A contract/mint address on one chain. Distinct from Asset because the same economic asset has many tokens (bridged and wrapped forms), and distinct from Coin because coins are market rows. Implemented today only in TS as DexToken (apps/web/src/features/market/dex/client.ts), with an address-family classifier (addressKind: base58 | hex | name) because DexScreener accepts three address shapes. The Rust sync carries a LOSSY stand-in: it labels SPL holdings `SPL:<first 6 characters of the mint>` (apps/reconciler/src/streams/sync.rs), which cannot be a token id.

address.description: The contract/mint address in the chain's own casing. Validated per family by apps/web/src/features/market/dex/client.ts MINT_RE / HEX_RE / NAME_RE.

address_kind.description: The address family detected from the string itself (addressKind).

asset_id.description: Null today: resolving a token to an asset requires the mapping table that does not exist.
